Started with a blank sheet.
Built for AI from day one.
ns.om.003: Builtly was founded in 2026 by people from real estate, engineering and AI. We had no legacy systems to protect, so we rebuilt engineering work from scratch: AI agents read and write, verified calculations produce the numbers, and the engineer in the discipline assesses and signs. The engineers build the tools themselves, and we also sell the technology as software.
ns.om.010: How we workWhat applies to everything we deliver
ns.om.011:
Two business areas.
One way of working.
ns.om.012: In consulting, we do the engineering for you. The software is the tools we have built, for those who want to do the work themselves. You can buy one without the other.
ns.om.013: The agents read. The tools calculate. The engineer signs.
ns.om.014: AI agents do the groundwork, the numbers come from verified calculations, and the engineer in the discipline checks and signs everything that goes out.
ns.om.016: AI is not an IT project here. The engineers build the agents and calculations they use themselves, together with the AI team.
ns.om.017: You pay for the deliverable, not for the hours.
ns.om.018: We mainly price the deliverable. What is agreed is what you pay.
ns.om.020: We have built the tools we need and left out software we do not need. You see it in the price.
ns.om.021: Three disciplines today. More on the way.
ns.om.022: We have people for geotechnics, structural engineering and building physics today. The goal is every discipline in a building project, and new disciplines come when the people are in place.
ns.om.024: If you use the software, our consultants do not see your projects unless you invite us.
ns.om.025: See how we work in consulting →
ns.om.026: The peopleOperational leadership, sales, board and advisors
ns.om.028: Engineering and AI in the same team. The engineers who sign also build the tools, together with researchers from AI and large software deliveries. In larger firms, AI often becomes the IT department's job while the engineers are expected to stay billable. Here, the engineers drive it themselves.
ns.om.041: Want to build the engineering firm of the future?
ns.om.042: We advertise positions when we have them, and we would like to hear from engineers in our disciplines who want to work with agents and our own calculations.
